# Vendored agents

`raven/` holds the parts of [Raven Checkers](https://github.com/bcorfman/raven-checkers) that its agent needs: the board model and the alpha-beta search. The files are unmodified, from commit `bc050df5cf2e16401998c493655082da94690a11`. Raven Checkers is by Brandon Corfman and released under MIT-0; see `raven/LICENSE`.

`engine/raven_agent.py` connects it to The Thinking Room's board.
